edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 for the Shares, payable in full at Closing by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller, without set-off or deduction except as required by applicable law.

2. Closing. Closing shall occur within 30 days of signing on a date agreed by the parties, subject to receipt of any required regulatory approvals, or on such other date as the parties agree in writing. Transfer of the Shares and payment of the Purchase Price shall occur simultaneously.

3. Representations. Subject to matters fairly disclosed in the disclosure schedule delivered by the Seller at signing, the Seller represents that the financial statements delivered to the Buyer have been prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standards consistently applied and fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the Company for the periods to which they relate.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement and the negotiations relating to it confidential, except for disclosures required by law or regulation or made to its professional advisers, financing sources or representatives who need to know such information and are subject to confidentiality obligations. Neither party shall make a public announcement concerning the transaction without the other party's prior written consent, except as required by law or regulation.

edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The proposed purchase price for the Shares is USD 40,000,000 on a cash-free, debt-free basis and assuming an agreed normal level of working capital, subject to Seller and Buyer approval and definitive documentation. The definitive agreement shall specify the definitions of cash, debt, debt-like items and working capital, the working-capital target, applicable accounting principles and illustrative calculations, without double counting. It shall provide for estimated adjustments at Closing and a post-Closing true-up, with agreed preparation and review periods, access to supporting records and resolution of disputed accounting items by an independent accountant. The amount payable at Closing shall be paid by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller, without set-off or deduction except withholding required by applicable law and any expressly agreed escrow or holdback. Any escrow or holdback, including its amount, purpose, duration and release mechanics, remains subject to express agreement and shall not be presumed. The Buyer shall provide reasonable advance notice of any required withholding, cooperate in obtaining available exemptions or reductions, timely remit withheld amounts to the relevant authority and provide evidence of remittance; amounts so remitted shall be treated as paid to the Seller.

2. Closing. The parties shall work toward prompt completion of diligence and negotiation of satisfactory definitive documentation, with diligence to be completed before signing. Closing shall occur on a mutually agreed date following satisfaction or waiver, where legally permissible, of the expressly agreed closing conditions, including required regulatory and other agreed third-party approvals. The definitive agreement shall specify objective closing conditions, appropriate efforts covenants, an agreed long-stop date and termination rights; it shall not provide an open-ended post-signing diligence condition. No unconditional 30-day Closing obligation is imposed. Transfer of the Shares and payment of the amount due at Closing shall occur simultaneously.

3. Representations, Covenants and Indemnification. The definitive agreement shall contain negotiated Seller representations concerning title to the Shares, authority, capitalization, financial statements, undisclosed liabilities, tax, material contracts, litigation and compliance with applicable law. The financial-statement representation shall address preparation in accordance with applicable accounting standards consistently applied and fair presentation, in all material respects, of the Company's financial position and results for the relevant periods. Representations shall be subject to appropriate scope, materiality and knowledge qualifications and matters fairly disclosed with sufficient detail to identify their nature and scope in disclosure schedules delivered at signing; cross-disclosure shall apply where relevance is reasonably apparent. The definitive agreement shall also include customary interim ordinary-course operating covenants, with agreed exceptions and Buyer consent not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed. Indemnification remains subject to agreement on survival periods, de minimis thresholds, a basket, caps, claims procedures and appropriate distinct treatment of fundamental and tax matters. Protections shall include mitigation, no double recovery, credit for insurance proceeds actually received net of recovery costs, and an exclusive contractual remedy for covered claims, with an appropriately defined fraud exception. No unlimited liability, escrow or holdback is agreed by this draft.

4. Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement, the negotiations relating to it and nonpublic transaction information received from the other party confidential, except for disclosures required by law or regulation or made to its professional advisers, representatives, prospective financing sources and their respective advisers who need to know such information for evaluating, financing or implementing the transaction and are subject to appropriate confidentiality obligations, including applicable professional duties. Each party shall be responsible for compliance by its permitted recipients, other than recipients bound by separate confidentiality undertakings directly enforceable by the disclosing party. Where legally permitted, a party making a legally required disclosure shall give reasonable advance notice and cooperate in seeking confidential treatment. Neither party shall make a public announcement concerning the transaction without the other party's prior written consent, except as required by law or regulation.

Thank you. The revised draft provides a useful basis for exchanging fuller documentation, but we cannot confirm agreement at USD 40 million.

For discussion, subject to our client's approval, satisfactory pre-signing diligence and definitive documentation, we counter at USD 35 million on the cash-free, debt-free basis described in your draft, with an agreed normalized working-capital target and the proposed estimated-adjustment and post-Closing true-up mechanics. Definitions and calculations must prevent double counting.

Our proposal also includes a 10% indemnity escrow for 18 months, with retention for timely notified unresolved claims. As an initial indemnification framework, we propose 18-month survival for general representations, a 0.5% deductible basket and a 20% general cap. Fundamental representations, tax, fraud and any identified diligence exposures would receive separately agreed treatment. These are proposed terms, not protections assumed to have been accepted in your draft.

We accept the approach of completing diligence before signing and using objective closing conditions thereafter, rather than an open-ended diligence condition. The fuller draft should include representation-accuracy and material covenant-compliance conditions, required approvals and absence of legal restraints, together with appropriate efforts covenants, a long-stop date and termination rights.

Please also expand the representation package to cover assets, intellectual property, employment and benefits, data protection and cybersecurity. Knowledge and materiality qualifications should be tailored to the particular representation rather than applied generally. We can work from the revised confidentiality and statutory withholding provisions.

Please confirm whether the Seller is prepared to progress on this revised commercial basis. All proposals remain subject to contract and client approval; no binding purchase commitment arises from this exchange.
